Seer.rationale_short: When the village questioned the mechanics, you should have pivoted from listing 'clears' to explaining the rules.

Guard.rationale_short: You must understand that 'no deaths' can be caused by either the Guard or the Witch.
By calling the Witch a liar, you created a fake contradiction that the wolves exploited.

Villager.rationale_short: In this game, if a Witch uses a save potion on a target the wolves attacked, no one dies.
When the Seer cleared the Guard, you should have trusted that data regardless of your personal feelings toward the Seer's tone.
Never prioritize 'vibes' or perceived 'urgency' over a Seer's confirmed clearance.
